step: Stop any deployment already in flight
about: One staging rollback's stop step: its env, the AWS answers it was given, in call order, and every line it printed. Each value says whether it is verbatim from the run's log or reconstructed from the step's own messages. The log masks the account inside each ARN; the mask is replaced by 123456789012 inside the ARN's account field only. No other text is changed.

waiting up to about 5 minutes for the deployment group to have no active deployment: stopping with auto-rollback makes CodeDeploy create its own revert of what was stopped, usually finished in a few seconds
